title: Downloading and Using the FitOn App
description:
This video will take you through step by step instructions for using the Workout and Wellness App called FitOn.

*All of the workouts are ALWAYS free -- there are options to upgrade for nutrition advice or to join specific programs. YOU DO NOT HAVE TO UPGRADE TO THE PAID VERSION!

I have used this app for the last 5 years. It is my favorite workout app because the WORKOUTS ARE ALWAYS FREE!! 

Watch the Video, and please reach out if you have any questions.
